setup: CREATE DOMAIN audit_number AS numeric CHECK (VALUE >= 0)

CREATE TABLE audit_b (id int PRIMARY KEY, i int, n numeric, d date, t timestamp, a int[], m audit_mood, label audit_label, dn audit_number, c text COLLATE "C", e text COLLATE "en-x-icu", "K" numeric, k float8, "P" char(4), p text)
CREATE VIEW audit_case_view AS SELECT "K",k FROM audit_b WHERE id=1
CREATE FUNCTION audit_rec() RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT "K",k FROM audit_b WHERE id=1 LOOP RETURN (r."K" = r.k)::text; END LOOP; RETURN 'none'; END$$
